title: Elder Life App
soWhat: A phone companion designed for older adults: weather and going-out advice, clinic and medication reminders, a magnifier, and AI Q&A — and the reminders export as plain text so family can set them up on the user's behalf.
problem: Older adults are put off by the type sizes and layered menus of ordinary apps, and most health apps assume a smartphone-savvy user who is comfortable keeping personal data in the cloud.
role: Sole developer, covering the app features, the local data encryption, and the backend integration.
method: Built with Flutter for Android on a local-first architecture
Contacts, reminders, and settings live in an encrypted on-device database (Hive + AES), so the app works without a network
Only the AI Q&A needs the self-hosted backend
Reminders export to a block of text, which can be pasted back in when switching phones or asking family for help
